shape.annular_segment.summary: Extrude an expression-driven annular sector between inner and outer radii across a start/sweep span. Returns feature, bodies, healthState, message, helpers, local refs and dependency scope.

inputs.name: Required feature name; reserves name and name__section (plus name__plane when a frame is declared).
inputs.innerRadius: Positive inner radius expression, strictly less than outerRadius.
inputs.height: Positive extrusion length expression along the sketch normal.
inputs.center: Three sketch-local length expressions for the arc center, default [0 mm,0 mm,0 mm]; z must evaluate to zero. Use plane/frame for 3D orientation.
inputs.start: Angular expression measured from sketch +X, default 0 deg.
inputs.sweep: Angular expression with magnitude in (0,360 deg), default 180 deg; use shape.ring for a full annulus.
inputs.plane: Native construction plane reference, default XY; mutually exclusive with frame.
inputs.frame: Named datum.frame or frame descriptor; creates a native plane aligned to the frame.
inputs.participants: Optional nonempty native body ref array for cut/intersect extrusion.

limitations: Inner and outer radii are driving radial dimensions; start/sweep expressions initialize arc geometry only. Center is sketch-local and planar. Raw coordinates are initial values, not parameter links.
Multi-operation recipe is not atomic; solver/kernel failures can leave helpers. Component scope only. Frame-derived plane geometry is constant and must be regenerated after source frame changes.

shape.arc_strip.summary: Extrude a curved strip built from a centerline arc or three-point circle with normal thickness. The blade center is explicit, never assumed at the global origin. Returns feature, bodies, healthState, message, helpers, refs and dependency scope.

inputs.name: Required feature name; reserves name and name__section (plus name__plane when a frame is declared).
inputs.thickness: Positive normal (radial) thickness expression retained inside both offset-radius driving dimensions.
inputs.centerline: Arc descriptor {radius,start?,sweep?,center?} or three-point descriptor {start,through,end}; mutually exclusive with a top-level radius.
inputs.radius: Top-level centerline radius when centerline is omitted; combines with top-level start/sweep/center.
inputs.sweep: Angular expression with magnitude in (0,360 deg], default 90 deg.
inputs.center: Three sketch-local length expressions for the strip center, default [0 mm,0 mm,0 mm].
inputs.plane: Native construction plane, default XY; mutually exclusive with frame.
inputs.frame: Named datum.frame or frame descriptor; creates a native aligned plane.
inputs.participants: Optional nonempty native body ref array for cut/intersect extrusion.

limitations: Offset radii encode thickness as native expressions; centerline start/sweep and through-points are initial values only. Three-point centers are computed locally and are numeric snapshots. Off-origin centers require the explicit center/centerline input.
Recipe is not atomic; kernel failures can leave helpers. Component scope only. Normal thickness is exact only for circular centerlines.

shape.can.summary: Compose a revolved blank, an opening shell and optional edge fillets into a can. Reuses model.revolve/shell/fillet. Returns blank/shell/fillets plus feature wiring and helpers.

inputs.name: Required feature name; reserves name and name__section.
inputs.height: Positive height expression retained as a driving dimension.
inputs.diameter: Positive blank diameter; exclusive with profileData/profile. Revolves a dimensioned rectangle about the axis.
inputs.profileData: Structured revolve profile {plane?,geometry,constraints?,dimensions?}; exclusive with diameter/profile.
inputs.profile: Existing native closed profile; exclusive with diameter/profileData.
inputs.axis: Revolve axis, default Y; only X/Y/Z support automatic opening-face and fillet-edge discovery.
inputs.plane: Native construction plane, default XY; mutually exclusive with frame.
inputs.opening: top (default), bottom or none; shell removes the extreme cap face.
inputs.radii: Array of positive fillet radius expressions applied to circular edges from the axis-extreme outward.
inputs.operation: newBody (default), join, cut or intersect for the blank revolve.

limitations: Blank revolve, shell and fillets are distinct native features; no atomic rollback. Opening-face and fillet-edge discovery uses centroid/center extremes along an X/Y/Z axis only. Wall thickness is uniform inside; a distinct bottom thickness is not modeled by the shell recipe.
Native face/edge discovery requires the blank body to expose topology; the recipe reports helpers but does not verify shell feasibility.

shape.impeller.summary: Generate a hub cylinder, a seed blade arc-strip joined to it, an optional shroud/disk revolve and a circular blade pattern. Geometry generator, not aerodynamic design. Returns hub/blade/pattern and helpers with feature dependencies.

inputs.name: Required pattern name; reserves name plus hub/blade helper names.
inputs.blade: Descriptor {thickness,radius?|innerRadius?|outerRadius?,start?,sweep?,height?,centerline?}; a seed arc-strip joined to the hub body. radius is the centerline; outerRadius/innerRadius are reduced to centerline radius plus strip thickness. The seed blade is extruded with a join that targets the hub implicitly: the blade must reach the hub (supply innerRadius equal to the hub radius, or a radius/thickness whose inner edge is no greater than the hub radius); an outerRadius-only blade with an inner edge beyond the hub radius joins no body and produces a detached blade.
inputs.count: Integer >=2 or unitless parameter expression; includes the seed blade.
inputs.shroud: Optional {profileData,thickness?}; revolved shroud profile joined to the hub.
inputs.disk: Optional {profileData,thickness?}; revolved disk profile joined to the hub.
inputs.plane: Native construction plane, default XY; mutually exclusive with frame.
inputs.trim: Optional participant body refs trimming the blade.
inputs.participants: Optional native body refs limiting the blade extrusion.

limitations: The seed blade extrudes joined to the hub body; the circular pattern depends on the blade feature. Shroud/disk are revolved profiles, not swept aerodynamic surfaces. Geometry generator only: no flow, blade-count or structural design.
Recipe is not atomic; kernel failures can leave hub/blade/pattern features. Blade centerline/arc inputs are initial values; radii remain driving dimensions.

shape.boss_pattern.summary: Generate a seed boss cylinder with an optional coaxial hole/insert, then repeat it in a rectangular, circular or explicit-list layout. Returns boss/hole/pattern with real helper and feature dependencies.

inputs.name: Required pattern name; reserves boss and hole helper names.
inputs.boss: Descriptor {diameter,height}; positive diameter and height. Seed is a dimension-driven cylinder.
inputs.hole: Optional {diameter,depth}; a native hole whose participants are the boss body.
inputs.insert: Optional {diameter,depth}; treated as a hole-sized insert recess.
inputs.frame: Named datum.frame or frame descriptor orienting the seed plane.
inputs.plane: Native construction plane, default XY; mutually exclusive with frame.
inputs.extent: Recorded extent descriptor; the seed boss/cylinder retains its own height.
inputs.participants: Optional native body refs limiting the boss extrusion.
inputs.operation: newBody (default), join, cut or intersect for the seed boss.

limitations: The hole (when present) depends on the boss body; the pattern depends on the seed feature(s). List layouts emit per-position seed copies rather than a native pattern feature.
Recipe is not atomic. insert and hole share the same recess recipe and are not distinct insert geometry.
